explication: This repository is a Simplified Chinese translation of The Rust Programming Language, with code listings and tools for producing ebook formats. The reader-facing workflow is to read the book through a supported format; the documented EPUB workflow runs the Rust builder, which prepares chapters and links before invoking Pandoc. The available tree and excerpts expose the EPUB implementation and sample listings, but not the manuscript or the internals of the mdBook, PDF, or GitBook workflows, so those links reflect README documentation only.
